tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__browser_batch
tools.description: Execute a sequence of Browser pane tool calls in ONE round trip. Each item is {name, input} where input is exactly what you'd pass to that tool standalone. Actions execute SEQUENTIALLY (not in parallel) and stop on the first error. Use this tool extensively to quickly execute work whenever you can predict two or more steps ahead — e.g. navigate, click a field, type, press Return, screenshot. Each tool's own permission check runs per item — a step on a site the user hasn't allowed either asks the user inline (and continues if they allow) or is refused, which stops the batch; if a step is refused for a missing permission, call that tool on its own (that call can ask the user), then batch the rest. Screenshots and other images are returned interleaved with outputs; coordinates you write in THIS batch refer to the screenshot taken BEFORE this call. browser_batch cannot be nested, and preview_start is not batchable — but if the Browser pane isn't open yet, a batch whose FIRST action is navigate with a url opens it (other actions still need an open page).

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
tools.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

schema.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__computer
schema.description: Mouse/keyboard automation in the Browser pane. Clicks accept either `coordinate` (pixels in the coordinate frame of the most recent `computer{action:"screenshot"}` — reported with every scaled screenshot; equal to the image's pixels for unscaled ones) or `ref` (a `ref_N` from read_page/find). Whenever you intend to click on an element like an icon, you should consult a screenshot to determine the coordinates of the element first; after the tab loads a different site, take a new screenshot before clicking by `coordinate`.

tabId.description: Tab to act on within the preview context. Omit for the fronted tab; get ids from tabs_context.

action.description:
The action to perform:
* `left_click`: Click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `right_click`: Click the right mouse button at the specified coordinates to open context menus.
* `double_click`: Double-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `triple_click`: Triple-click the left mouse button at the specified coordinates.
* `type`: Type a string of text.
* `screenshot`: Take a screenshot of the screen.
* `wait`: Wait for a specified number of seconds.
* `scroll`: Scroll up, down, left, or right at the specified coordinates.
* `key`: Press a specific keyboard key.
* `left_click_drag`: Drag from start_coordinate to coordinate.
* `zoom`: Take a screenshot of a specific region for closer inspection.
* `scroll_to`: Scroll an element into view using its element reference ID from read_page or find tools.
* `hover`: Move the mouse cursor to the specified coordinates or element without clicking. Useful for revealing tooltips, dropdown menus, or triggering hover states.

coordinate.description: (x, y): The x (pixels from the left edge) and y (pixels from the top edge) coordinates. Required for `left_click`, `right_click`, `double_click`, `triple_click`, and `scroll`. For `left_click_drag`, this is the end position.

text.description: The text to type (for `type` action) or the key(s) to press (for `key` action). For `key` action: Provide space-separated keys (e.g., "Backspace Backspace Delete"). Supports keyboard shortcuts using the platform's modifier key (use "cmd" on Mac, "ctrl" on Windows/Linux, e.g., "cmd+a" or "ctrl+a" for select all). Page zoom shortcuts (e.g. "cmd+=", "ctrl+-", "cmd+0") are not supported - use the `zoom` action to magnify a region of the page instead.

duration.description: The number of seconds to wait. Required for `wait`. Maximum 10 seconds.

scroll_direction.description: The direction to scroll. Required for `scroll`.

scroll_amount.description: The number of scroll wheel ticks. Optional for `scroll`, defaults to 3.

region.description: (x0, y0, x1, y1): The rectangular region to capture for `zoom`. Coordinates define a rectangle from top-left (x0, y0) to bottom-right (x1, y1) in pixels from the viewport origin. Required for `zoom` action. Useful for inspecting small UI elements like icons, buttons, or text.

scale.description: For `screenshot` and `zoom` only. Scale factor in [0.1, 1] for the returned image; 1 (default) uses the full image token budget, 0.5 returns an image at half the width and height (~quarter of the tokens). Coordinates are ALWAYS in the full-resolution coordinate frame (reported with every scaled screenshot), never in the scaled image's own pixels.

repeat.description: Number of times to repeat the key sequence. Only applicable for `key` action. Must be a positive integer between 1 and 100. Default is 1. Useful for navigation tasks like pressing arrow keys multiple times.

ref.description: Element reference ID from read_page or find tools (e.g., "ref_1", "ref_2"). Required for `scroll_to` action. Can be used as alternative to `coordinate` for click actions.

modifiers.description: Modifier keys for click actions. Supports: "ctrl", "shift", "alt", "cmd" (or "meta"), "win" (or "windows"). Can be combined with "+" (e.g., "ctrl+shift", "cmd+alt"). Optional.

action_summary.description: A few words saying what this action does on the page and to what, for example 'Sends the drafted reply to pat@example.com' or 'Opens the Filters menu'. Set it on every left_click, right_click, double_click, triple_click, left_click_drag, key and type action. State the effect only, and accurately: no reasons, nothing about what you were asked or allowed to do, no passwords or other secrets.

tools.name: mcp__Claude_Browser__resize_window
tools.description: Emulate a viewport size in the Browser pane tab. Presets: mobile (375x812), tablet (768x1024), or desktop, which clears the size emulation and returns the tab to the pane's own responsive size. Custom sizes need both width and height. An emulated size applies to that tab across reloads and navigation (scaled down to fit when it is larger than the pane): reset it with preset "desktop" as soon as you finish testing. The desktop app may also clear a size you set when your turn ends, so set it again in a later turn if you still need it. A size the user picked from the pane's own Viewport menu is theirs and stays until they or you change it; leave it unless they ask. colorScheme (light/dark) emulates prefers-color-scheme on that tab; it survives reloads and preset "desktop" does not touch it, but the pane re-syncs the tab to the app's light/dark theme when that theme changes or the pane reopens; local documents and static HTML previews always render light. The mobile preset (and any width < 768) also emulates a mobile device: Android Chrome user agent and 5 touch points, so pages detect a touch phone; your clicks still arrive as mouse clicks. Reload the page after switching so load-time device gates re-run.

loading_messages.description: 1–4 loading messages shown to the user while the visual renders, each roughly 5 words long. Write them in the same language the user is using. Use 1 for simple visuals, more for complex ones. If the topic is serious — illness, disease, pandemics, death, grief, war, conflict, poverty, disaster, trauma, abuse, addiction, medical decisions, politically charged subjects, or anything where the reader might be personally affected — keep these BORING: describe what the code is doing in the dullest generic way, no jargon-as-drama, no evocative terms. Pandemic growth model — NOT ['Simulating patient zero', 'Modeling the curve'] (documentary-narrator voice), YES ['Setting up the model', 'Running the calculation']. Cancer timeline — NOT ['Charting the battle ahead'], YES ['Laying out the stages']. If you have to ask whether it's serious, it is. Otherwise, have fun — reach for alliteration, puns, personification, wordplay, whatever lands in that language. Playful examples — revenue chart: ['Bribing bars to stand taller', 'Asking Q4 where it went']; kanban: ['Herding cards into columns', 'Dragging, dropping, not stopping'].

title.description: Short snake_case identifier for this visual. Must be specific and disambiguating — if the conversation has multiple visuals, this title alone should tell you which one is being referenced (e.g. 'q4_revenue_by_product_line' not 'chart', 'oauth_login_flow' not 'diagram'). Also used as the download filename, so no spaces or special characters.

Example: <svg viewBox="0 0 700 400" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">...</svg>. For HTML: raw HTML content to render, do NOT include DOCTYPE, <html>, <head>, or <body> tags. Use CSS variables for theming. Keep background transparent and avoid top-level padding. Scripts are supported but execute after streaming completes.

"""The one-click assembly line: footage + mic (+ title/context) in, finished video + shorts out."""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import time

from .paths import project_dir


def step(name: str):
    print(f"\n=== {name} ===", flush=True)
    return time.time()


def run_auto(slug: str, mode: str | None = None, final: bool = False, shorts: int | None = None,
             model: str = "large-v3-turbo", replan: bool = False) -> None:
    proj = project_dir(slug)
    if shorts is None:                                     # [settings] shorts.enabled / shorts.count
        from .settings import load as load_settings
        sh = load_settings(slug)["shorts"]
        shorts = int(sh["count"]) if sh["enabled"] else 0
    t0 = time.time()
    if not (proj / "work" / "transcript.json").exists():
        step("transcribe")
        from .transcribe import transcribe
        transcribe(slug, model)
    if not (proj / "work" / "signals.json").exists():
        step("analyze")
        from .analyze import analyze
        analyze(slug)
    edl_p = proj / "edit.json"
    hand_made = edl_p.exists() and json.loads(edl_p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")).get("generator") != "autoplan"
    if not edl_p.exists() or replan or not hand_made:
        step("autoplan")
        from .autoplan import autoplan
        autoplan(slug, mode)
    else:
        print("\n(keeping the existing hand-made edit.json - pass --replan to overwrite)")
    step("render " + ("final" if final else "preview"))
    from .render import render
    out = render(slug, preview=not final, record=final)
    made = []
    if shorts:
        step(f"shorts x{shorts}")
        from .shorts import make_shorts
        made = make_shorts(slug, shorts, render=True, preview=not final)
    print(f"\n✔ done in {time.time() - t0:.0f}s\n  video : {out}")
    for s in made:
        print(f"  short : projects/{s}/out/")
"""Create a project from raw recordings.

    mcs new ep01 --game "D:/OBS/2026-10-06 20-11-02.mkv"                 # OBS multi-track file
    mcs new ep01 --game gameplay.mp4 --mic mic.wav --mic-offset 0.42      # separate mic recording
    mcs new ep01 --game gameplay.mkv --mic-stream 1 --game-stream 0

Raw files are referenced in place (not copied) unless --copy is given.
Recommended OBS setup: Output > Recording > Audio Track 1 = game (desktop audio),
Track 2 = mic. Then sync is perfect and `--mic-stream 1` is automatic.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path

from .paths import PROJECTS
from .render import probe


def audio_streams(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    return [s for s in probe(path).get("streams", []) if s["codec_type"] == "audio"]


def new_project(slug: str, game: str, mic: str | None, mic_stream: int | None, game_stream: int,
                mic_offset: float, title: str | None, copy: bool, facecam: str | None = None,
                facecam_offset: float = 0.0, context: str = "") -> Path:
    proj = PROJECTS / slug
    if (proj / "project.json").exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"project {slug} already exists")
    for d in ("raw", "work", "out", "overlays"):
        (proj / d).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    game_p = Path(game).resolve()
    if not game_p.exists():
        raise SystemExit(f"game recording not found: {game_p}")
    if copy:
        shutil.copy2(game_p, proj / "raw" / game_p.name)
        game_ref = f"raw/{game_p.name}"
    else:
        game_ref = str(game_p)
    streams = audio_streams(game_p)
    pr = probe(game_p)
    dur = float(pr.get("format", {}).get("duration", 0))
    sources: dict = {"game": {"file": game_ref, "video_stream": 0, "audio_stream": game_stream}}
    notes = []
    if mic:
        mic_p = Path(mic).resolve()
        if copy:
            shutil.copy2(mic_p, proj / "raw" / mic_p.name)
            mic_ref = f"raw/{mic_p.name}"
        else:
            mic_ref = str(mic_p)
        sources["mic"] = {"file": mic_ref, "stream": mic_stream or 0, "offset_s": mic_offset}
    elif mic_stream is not None or len(streams) >= 2:
        ms = 1 if mic_stream is None else mic_stream
        sources["mic"] = {"file": game_ref, "stream": ms, "offset_s": 0.0}
        if mic_stream is None:
            notes.append(f"assumed audio track {ms} is the mic and track {game_stream} is game audio - "
                         "check and edit project.json if wrong")
    else:
        notes.append("no separate mic found: transcription will run on the game audio track (mixed voice + game)")
    if facecam:
        fpath = Path(facecam).resolve()
        if not fpath.exists():
            raise SystemExit(f"facecam recording not found: {fpath}")
        sources["facecam"] = {"file": str(fpath), "offset_s": facecam_offset}
    pj = {"slug": slug, "title": title or slug, "context": context, "duration_s": round(dur, 2), "sources": sources,
          "audio_tracks": [{"index": i, "codec": s.get("codec_name"), "channels": s.get("channels"),
                            "title": (s.get("tags") or {}).get("title")} for i, s in enumerate(streams)],
          "notes": notes}
    (proj / "project.json").write_text(json.dumps(pj, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(pj, indent=2))
    return proj
"""Word-level transcription of the mic track (faster-whisper, CPU int8).

    mcs transcribe ep01                       # large-v3-turbo (best; ~1.6 GB model download on first run)
    mcs transcribe ep01 --model small.en      # quick drafts

Writes, in SOURCE time (seconds into the gameplay recording):
  work/transcript.json   segments + words with start/end/probability
  work/transcript.md     compact "[mm:ss.s] text" lines for the planner to read
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json
import subprocess
import time
from pathlib import Path

from .paths import project_dir


def extract_voice(proj: Path, pj: dict) -> tuple[Path, float]:
    src = pj["sources"]
    mic = src.get("mic")
    if mic:
        f, stream, off = mic["file"], mic.get("stream", 0), mic.get("offset_s", 0.0)
    else:
        f, stream, off = src["game"]["file"], src["game"].get("audio_stream", 0), 0.0
    out = proj / "work" / "voice16k.wav"
    path = Path(f) if Path(f).is_absolute() else proj / f
    if not out.exists() or out.stat().st_mtime < path.stat().st_mtime:
        subprocess.run(["ffmpeg", "-hide_banner", "-v", "error", "-y", "-i", str(path), "-map", f"0:a:{stream}",
                        "-ac", "1", "-ar", "16000", "-af", "highpass=f=80,loudnorm=I=-20", "-c:a", "pcm_s16le", str(out)], check=True)
    return out, off


def fmt(t: float) -> str:
    m, s = divmod(t, 60)
    return f"{int(m):02d}:{s:04.1f}"


def transcribe(slug: str, model: str = "large-v3-turbo", language: str | None = "en") -> Path:
    try:
        from faster_whisper import WhisperModel
    except ImportError:
        raise SystemExit("faster-whisper not installed: cd studio && uv sync --extra asr") from None
    proj = project_dir(slug)
    pj = json.loads((proj / "project.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    wav, offset = extract_voice(proj, pj)
    t0 = time.time()
    wm = WhisperModel(model, device="cpu", compute_type="int8", cpu_threads=0)
    # feed PCM directly: avoids faster-whisper's PyAV decode path (API drift between av releases)
    import wave

    import numpy as np
    with wave.open(str(wav), "rb") as wf:
        pcm = np.frombuffer(wf.readframes(wf.getnframes()), dtype=np.int16).astype(np.float32) / 32768.0
    segments, info = wm.transcribe(pcm, language=language, word_timestamps=True, vad_filter=True,
                                   vad_parameters={"min_silence_duration_ms": 300},
                                   condition_on_previous_text=False, beam_size=5)
    segs = []
    for s in segments:
        segs.append({
            "start": round(s.start - offset, 3), "end": round(s.end - offset, 3), "text": s.text.strip(),
            "words": [{"word": w.word.strip(), "start": round(w.start - offset, 3), "end": round(w.end - offset, 3),
                       "p": round(w.probability, 3)} for w in (s.words or [])],
        })
        print(f"  [{fmt(segs[-1]['start'])}] {segs[-1]['text']}", flush=True)
    out = {"model": model, "language": info.language, "duration_s": info.duration, "mic_offset_s": offset,
           "segments": segs}
    (proj / "work" / "transcript.json").write_text(json.dumps(out, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False), encoding="utf-8")
    md = [f"# Transcript {slug} (source time, model {model})", ""]
    md += [f"[{fmt(s['start'])}-{fmt(s['end'])}] {s['text']}" for s in segs]
    (proj / "work" / "transcript.md").write_text("\n".join(md) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"[transcribe] {len(segs)} segments in {time.time() - t0:.0f}s -> work/transcript.json")
    return proj / "work" / "transcript.json"

    p = PROJECTS / slug

    return p


def pack_path(rel: str) -> Path:

def _b(key, label, default, help_, applies, **kw):
    return {"key": key, "label": label, "type": "bool", "default": default, "help": help_, "applies": applies, **kw}

            "applies": applies, "options": options, **kw}

"""mcs - Minecraft editing studio CLI.  Run `uv run mcs <command> -h` (from studio/) for details.

Assembly line:
  mcs new <slug> --game rec.mkv [--mic mic.wav]   create project
  mcs transcribe <slug>                           word-level transcript (source time)
  mcs analyze <slug>                              loudness/scene signals + frame sheets
  mcs scaffold <slug>                             first-pass edit.json (dead air removed)
  (planner edits edit.json: zooms, SFX, memes, greenscreens, text, bleeps, music)
  mcs check <slug>                                validate + timeline digest + policy warnings
  mcs render <slug> [--preview]                   ffmpeg render -> out/<slug>.mp4
Library:
  mcs assets find|show|stats                      query the editing-pack database
  mcs assets fav|unfav <ids...> / favs            star assets so the auto-editor prefers them
  mcs frames <slug> --from S --to E               frame sheet for a moment
  mcs ui                                          local web UI at http://127.0.0.1:8765
One click:
  mcs make <slug> --game rec.mkv [--mic m.wav] [--facecam cam.mp4] --title "..." --context "..."
  mcs auto <slug> [--final] [--shorts 3]          transcribe -> analyze -> autoplan -> render -> shorts
  mcs autoplan <slug> [--mode funny]              heuristic creative pass (no LLM needed)
  mcs engage <slug>                               add attention zooms to an existing edit
  mcs shorts <slug> [--count 3] [--render]        cut 9:16 shorts from the edit
Settings:
  mcs settings show [--slug S] [--changed]        feature switches (filters, SFX, memes, zooms, templates...)
  mcs settings set <section.key> <value> [--slug S]   e.g. looks.enabled off / motion.disabled_templates boss_bar
  mcs settings reset [section] [--slug S]
Libraries:
  mcs library add|scan|status                     your Stock Library (B-roll, stock, memes)
  mcs motion list|render <template> --var k=v     channel motion-graphics templates (HyperFrames)
  mcs avatar build|preview                        narrator avatar from brand/avatar/skin.png
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import sys


def cmd_assets(a):
    from . import assets as A
    if a.action == "stats":
        print(json.dumps(A.stats(), indent=2))
        return
    if a.action == "show":
        for i in a.ids:
            print(json.dumps(A.get(i), indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))
        return
    if a.action in ("fav", "unfav"):
        if not a.ids:
            raise SystemExit(f"usage: mcs assets {a.action} <id> [<id> ...]")
        bad = 0
        for i in a.ids:
            try:
                d = A.set_favorite(i, a.action == "fav")
                print(f"{'*' if d['favorite'] else '-'} {d['id']}" + (f"  (redirected from {i})" if d["id"] != i else ""))
            except KeyError:
                print(f"unknown asset {i}", file=sys.stderr)
                bad += 1
        if bad:
            sys.exit(1)
        return
    if a.action == "favs":
        res = A.favorites()
        if a.json:
            print(json.dumps(res, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))
        else:
            for r in res:
                print(f"* {r['id']:<50} {r['category']:<14} {r['title']}")
            print(f"({len(res)} favourites)")
        return
    q = A.Query(moments=a.moment or [], roles=a.role or [], categories=a.category or [], kinds=a.kind or [],
                key_modes=a.key_mode or [], placement=a.placement or [], text=a.text, max_rating=a.max_rating,
                max_risk=a.max_risk, min_energy=a.min_energy, max_energy=a.max_energy,
                max_duration=a.max_duration, min_duration=a.min_duration, exclude=a.exclude or [],
                project=a.project, limit=a.limit, seed=a.seed, favorites_only=a.favorites)
    res = A.find(q)
    if a.json:
        print(json.dumps(res, indent=1, ensure_ascii=False))
    else:
        for r in res:
            print(A.brief(r))
        if not res:
            print("(no matches - loosen filters, try --text, or raise --max-rating/--max-risk)")


def cmd_check(a):
    from . import assets as A
    from .edl import build_spans, load, resolve_time, total_duration
    from .paths import STYLE, project_dir
    proj = project_dir(a.slug)
    edl = load(proj / "edit.json")
    style = json.loads(STYLE.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    pace = style["pacing"]
    warnings, errors = [], []

    def lookup(i):
        try:
            return A.get(i)
        except KeyError:
            errors.append(f"unknown asset {i}")
            return None
    spans = build_spans(edl, lookup)
    total = total_duration(edl, lookup)
    rating_rank = {"clean": 0, "mild": 1, "explicit": 2, "banned": 3}
    max_default = rating_rank[edl.get("max_rating", pace["default_max_rating"])]
    first_max = rating_rank[pace["first_15s_max_rating"]]
    timeline = []

    def check_asset(aid, at, what, used_for=None):
        x = lookup(aid)
        if not x:
            return
        r = rating_rank.get(x.get("content_rating") or "explicit", 2)
        if r >= 3:
            errors.append(f"{what}: {aid} is BANNED content")
        elif at is not None and at < 15 and r > first_max:
            warnings.append(f"{what}: {aid} ({x['content_rating']}) in first 15s hurts monetization")
        elif r > max_default:
            warnings.append(f"{what}: {aid} rated {x['content_rating']} above the video's max_rating")
        if x.get("copyright_risk") == "high" and used_for is not None:
            limit = 10.0 if x["category"] == "music" else 6.0
            if used_for > limit:
                warnings.append(f"{what}: {aid} is copyrighted and plays {used_for:.0f}s - keep quick clips under "
                                f"~{limit:.0f}s (transformative use); copyrighted music beds are the usual Content ID claim")
        timeline.append((at if at is not None else -1, what, aid))

    t = 0.0
    for i, s in enumerate(edl["segments"]):
        if s.get("asset"):
            check_asset(s["asset"], t, f"segment {s.get('id', i)} cutaway", spans[i].out_end - spans[i].out_start)
        t = spans[i].out_end + s.get("freeze_end", 0.0)
    groups = [("overlay", edl.get("overlays", [])), ("sfx", edl.get("audio", {}).get("sfx", [])),
              ("music", edl.get("audio", {}).get("music", []))]
    counts = {}
    for name, evs in groups:
        counts[name] = len(evs)
        for k, ev in enumerate(evs):
            at = resolve_time(ev, spans, warnings, f"{name}[{k}]") if ("at" in ev or "src_at" in ev or "seg" in ev) else 0.0
            if ev.get("asset"):
                x = lookup(ev["asset"]) or {}
                if name == "music":
                    used = (ev.get("until", total) - (at or 0))
                else:
                    used = ev.get("dur") or ((x.get("tail_s") or x.get("duration_s") or 0) - (ev.get("in") or 0))
                check_asset(ev["asset"], at, f"{name}[{k}]", used)
    for k, ev in enumerate(edl.get("text", [])):
        at = resolve_time(ev, spans, warnings, f"text[{k}]")
        timeline.append((at if at is not None else -1, f"text[{k}]", ev.get("text")))
    mins = max(total / 60, 1e-6)
    zooms = sum(len([z for z in s.get("zoom", []) if not z.get("auto")]) for s in edl["segments"])
    auto_zooms = sum(len([z for z in s.get("zoom", []) if z.get("auto")]) for s in edl["segments"])
    cutaways = sum(1 for s in edl["segments"] if s.get("type") == "cutaway")
    density = {
        "sfx_per_minute": (counts["sfx"] / mins, pace["sfx_per_minute"]),
        "zooms_per_minute": (zooms / mins, pace["zooms_per_minute"]),
        "meme_cutaways_per_minute": (cutaways / mins, pace["meme_cutaways_per_minute"]),
        "greenscreens_per_minute": (sum(1 for o in edl.get("overlays", []) if o["type"] == "greenscreen") / mins,
                                    pace["greenscreens_per_minute"]),
    }
    src_segs = [s for s in edl["segments"] if s.get("type", "source") == "source"]
    avg_seg = sum((s["out"] - s["in"]) / s.get("speed", 1) for s in src_segs) / max(len(src_segs), 1)
    print(f"duration {total:.1f}s ({total / 60:.1f} min), {len(edl['segments'])} segments "
          f"(avg source shot {avg_seg:.1f}s), {cutaways} cutaways, {auto_zooms / mins:.1f} engagement zooms/min")
    for k, (v, (lo, hi)) in density.items():
        flag = "" if lo <= v <= hi else ("  <- LOW" if v < lo else "  <- HIGH")
        print(f"  {k:<26} {v:5.1f}  (target {lo}-{hi}){flag}")
    if a.timeline:
        for at, what, aid in sorted(timeline, key=lambda x: x[0]):
            m, s = divmod(max(at, 0), 60)
            print(f"  {int(m):02d}:{s:05.2f}  {what:<22} {aid}")
    for w in warnings:
        print("WARN ", w)
    for e in errors:
        print("ERROR", e)
    sys.exit(1 if errors else 0)


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="mcs", description=__doc__, formatter_class=argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter)
    sub = ap.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    p = sub.add_parser("new", help="create a project from recordings")
    p.add_argument("slug")
    p.add_argument("--game", required=True)
    p.add_argument("--mic")
    p.add_argument("--mic-stream", type=int)
    p.add_argument("--game-stream", type=int, default=0)
    p.add_argument("--mic-offset", type=float, default=0.0, help="seconds the mic recording started BEFORE the game recording")
    p.add_argument("--title")
    p.add_argument("--copy", action="store_true")

    p = sub.add_parser("transcribe")
    p.add_argument("slug")
    p.add_argument("--model", default="large-v3-turbo")
    p.add_argument("--language", default="en")

    p = sub.add_parser("analyze")
    p.add_argument("slug")
    p.add_argument("--every", type=float, default=10.0)

    p = sub.add_parser("frames")
    p.add_argument("slug")
    p.add_argument("--from", dest="start", type=float, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--to", dest="end", type=float, required=True)
    p.add_argument("--every", type=float, default=1.0)

    p = sub.add_parser("scaffold")
    p.add_argument("slug")

def render_segment(ctx: Ctx, i: int, seg: dict) -> Path:
    t = seg.get("type", "source")
    key = json.dumps([RENDER_VERSION, seg, ctx.W, ctx.H, ctx.FPS, ctx.enc_seg, ctx.style["audio"], ctx.sources,
                      round(ctx.voice_ref, 1), ctx.format, ctx.mode(seg), ctx.facecam,
                      ctx.looks.get(seg.get("look") or ctx.look),
                      # [settings] anything a switch changes in this segment's pixels/audio must change its hash
                      *ctx.seg_settings_key(seg)], sort_keys=True)
    h = hashlib.sha1(key.encode()).hexdigest()[:10]
    out = ctx.work / "segs" / f"{i:03d}_{h}.mkv"
    if out.exists():
        return out
    for stale in (ctx.work / "segs").glob(f"{i:03d}_*.mkv"):
        stale.unlink()
    args: list = []
    if t == "source":
        g = ctx.sources["game"]
        game = ctx.proj / g["file"]
        gp = probe(game)
        game_has_audio = any(s["codec_type"] == "audio" for s in gp.get("streams", []))
        speed = seg.get("speed", 1.0)
        src_dur = seg["out"] - seg["in"]
        args += ["-ss", f"{seg['in']:.4f}", "-t", f"{src_dur:.4f}", "-i", game]
        mic = ctx.sources.get("mic")
        mic_input = bool(mic)
        if mic and mic.get("file") and mic["file"] != g["file"]:
            off = mic.get("offset_s", 0.0)
            start = seg["in"] + off
            if start < 0:
                ctx.warnings.append(f"segment {i}: mic starts after this segment; mic muted")
                mic_input = False
            else:
                args += ["-ss", f"{start:.4f}", "-t", f"{src_dur:.4f}", "-i", ctx.proj / mic["file"]]
        fc_index = None
        if facecam_layout(ctx, seg):
            cam = ctx.sources["facecam"]
            start = seg["in"] + cam.get("offset_s", 0.0)
            if start >= 0:
                fc_index = len([a for a in args if a == "-i"])
                args += ["-ss", f"{start:.4f}", "-t", f"{src_dur:.4f}", "-i", ctx.proj / cam["file"]]
        fc, _ = source_segment_filter(ctx, seg, game_has_audio, mic_input, fc_index)
    else:
        if seg.get("template"):
            seg = {**seg, "file": str(motion_file(ctx, seg, opaque=True))}
        src = ctx.media_path(seg)
        a = ctx.asset(seg["asset"]) if seg.get("asset") else {}
        start = seg.get("in", a.get("use_in") or 0.0)
        from .edl import seg_duration
        dur = seg_duration(seg, ctx.asset_lookup) - seg.get("freeze_end", 0.0)
        args += ["-ss", f"{start:.4f}", "-t", f"{dur:.4f}", "-i", src]
        has_audio = any(s["codec_type"] == "audio" for s in probe(src).get("streams", []))
        vf = fit_filter(ctx.W, ctx.H, ctx.FPS, seg.get("blur_bg", True))
        freeze = seg.get("freeze_end", 0.0)
        tail = f",tpad=stop_mode=clone:stop_duration={freeze:.3f}" if freeze else ""
        fx = "".join("," + EFFECTS[e](ctx) for e in seg.get("effects", []) if e in EFFECTS)
        fc = f"[0:v]setpts=PTS-STARTPTS,{vf}{fx}{tail}[v];"
        total = dur + freeze
        vol = ctx.matched_db(a, ctx.style["audio"]["mix"]["cutaway_rel_db"], a.get("volume_db") or 0) \
            + seg.get("volume_db", 0)
        if has_audio and not seg.get("mute"):
            fc += (f"[0:a]asetpts=PTS-STARTPTS,volume={db(vol)},aresample=48000,aformat=channel_layouts=stereo,"
                   f"apad=whole_dur={total:.4f},atrim=0:{total:.4f}[a]")
        else:
            fc += f"anullsrc=r=48000:cl=stereo,atrim=0:{total:.4f}[a]"
    script = ctx.work / "segs" / f"{i:03d}.fc.txt"
    script.write_text(fc, encoding="utf-8")
    args += ["-/filter_complex", script, "-map", "[v]", "-map", "[a]", *venc(ctx.enc_seg),
             "-r", ctx.FPS, "-c:a", "pcm_s16le", "-ar", 48000, out]
    run_ff(args, ctx.work, ctx.log)
    return out

def sfx_timing(ctx: Ctx, ev: dict, at: float) -> tuple[float, float, float | None]:
    """-> (place_at, source_in, duration) honouring alignment to the asset's hit point."""
    a = ctx.asset(ev["asset"]) if ev.get("asset") else {}
    align = ev.get("align") or ("peak" if "hit" in a.get("roles", []) else "onset")
    src_in = ev.get("in", a.get("use_in") if a.get("use_in") is not None else (a.get("onset_s") or 0.0))
    place = at
    if align == "peak" and a.get("peak_s") is not None:
        place = at - max(0.0, a["peak_s"] - src_in)
    dur = ev.get("dur")
    if dur is None and a.get("use_out"):
        dur = a["use_out"] - src_in
    if dur is None and a.get("tail_s"):
        dur = a["tail_s"] - src_in + 0.05
    return max(0.0, place), src_in, dur

def _hits(text: str, theme: str) -> int:
def _theme_of(text: str, prefer: str | None = None) -> str | None:
    scores = {k: _hits(text, k) for k in THEMES}
    scores = {k: v for k, v in scores.items() if v}
    if not scores:
        return None
    best = max(scores.values())
    if prefer in scores and scores[prefer] >= best:
        return prefer
    return max(scores, key=lambda k: (scores[k], -PEAK_ORDER.index(k) if k in PEAK_ORDER else -99))


def title_case(s: str) -> str:
    small = {"a", "an", "the", "to", "of", "in", "on", "at", "for", "and", "or", "but", "by", "vs"}
    ws = s.strip().split()
    return " ".join(w if (w.isupper() and len(w) > 1) else (w.lower() if i and w.lower() in small else w[:1].upper() + w[1:])
                    for i, w in enumerate(ws))

    edl = p.plan()
    dest = p.proj / "edit.json"
    if dest.exists():
        hist = p.proj / "history"
        hist.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        from datetime import datetime
        dest.replace(hist / f"edit.{datetime.now():%Y%m%d-%H%M%S}.json")
    dest.write_text(json.dumps(edl, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    n = lambda k: len(edl[k]) if k in edl else 0  # noqa: E731
    print(f"[autoplan] {len(edl['segments'])} segments, {len(edl['audio']['sfx'])} sfx, {n('text')} text pops, "
          f"{n('overlays')} overlays, {len(edl['audio']['music'])} music beds, base mode {edl['mode']}")
    return dest

"""One-click creative pass: transcript + signals + project context -> a complete edit.json.

    mcs autoplan <slug> [--mode funny] [--no-cold-open] [--seed 1]
    mcs engage <slug>          # only the engagement pass (auto zooms) on an existing edit

This is the deterministic baseline so "add footage + mic -> video" works with no human or LLM in the
loop. A Claude pass (/mc-edit) on top is still better at context and jokes; it can start from this.

Pipeline:
  1. segments   keep speech (+ action peaks), drop dead air; "fast forward" gaps become 4x montages
  2. beats      keyword lexicon + voice peaks + death screens -> taxonomy moments with a score
  3. modes      each segment gets a mood from its beats (sad on deaths, scary on panic, ...)
  4. cold open  strongest late beat is teased first, then "N MINUTES EARLIER"
  5. treatments per beat: SFX / zoom / shake / freeze / text / meme cutaway / green screen, within budgets
  6. engage     guarantee a visual change every mode.zoom.every_s seconds (punch-ins, jump-cut reframes)
  7. music      one bed per run of the same mode; captions emphasis; watermark; outro CTA
Every event is anchored to its segment ({"seg": id, ...}) so shorts can be cut from the edit later.

    def assign_modes(self, segs: list[dict], beats: list[dict]) -> None:
        """The look stays in the base mode. It only changes for a real story SECTION: 8+ s of scary
        (panic/jumpscare run) or the sad ending after a death. Per-beat mood flips were unwatchable."""
        dur = lambda s: (s["out"] - s["in"]) / s.get("speed", 1)  # noqa: E731
        cand = []
        for s in segs:
            inside = [b for b in beats if s["in"] - 0.2 <= b["t"] < s["out"] and b["score"] >= 4]

            m = cand[i]

            j = i                                            # extend while the same mood keeps recurring
            while j + 1 < len(segs) and (cand[j + 1] == m or (j + 2 < len(segs) and cand[j + 2] == m)):

               "captions": {"enabled": S["captions"]["enabled"],                     # [settings]

        wm = self.brand.get("watermark", {})

        if Ca["engage_zooms"]:                                                    # [settings]
            engage(edl, self.words, self.modes)
        if S["audio"]["music"]:
            self.music(edl)
        for x in edl["audio"]["sfx"]:
            x.pop("_beat", None)
        return edl

    STICKER_MOMENTS = {"death", "shock", "jumpscare", "panic", "victory", "loot", "fail", "rage", "confusion",
                       "explosion", "irony", "flex"}

    def sticker_beat(self, b: dict, s: dict, overlays: list, busy: bool, duration: float) -> None:
        """The channel mascot reacts: a Crodie emote pops in a corner on a big beat (crying on a death, screaming
        on a jumpscare, heart eyes on loot). Sparse: strong beats only, >=25 s apart, ~1 per 40 s, never on a beat
        that already got a meme / green screen / game-UI graphic. A death screen is the payoff: it always gets the
        crying reaction, and the panic right before it stays clean so the two don't stack."""
        if busy or b["score"] < 4 or b["moment"] not in self.STICKER_MOMENTS \
                or not SET.template_ok(self.S, "sticker_pop"):     # [settings] brand.stickers / templates
            return
        deaths = [d["t"] for d in self.sig.get("death_screens", [])]
        if not b.get("death_screen") and any(0 < d - b["t"] < 15 for d in deaths):
            return                                       # leave the build-up clean for the death payoff

def render(slug: str, preview: bool = False, record: bool = True) -> Path:
    ctx = Ctx(slug, preview)
    edl = ctx.edl
    cut_notes = [] if edl.get("guard_cuts") is False else guard_cuts(ctx)
    spans = build_spans(edl, ctx.asset_lookup)
    total = total_duration(edl, ctx.asset_lookup)
    print(f"[render] {slug}: {len(edl['segments'])} segments, {total:.1f}s, {ctx.W}x{ctx.H}@{ctx.FPS}"
          f"{' (preview)' if preview else ''}", flush=True)

    with ThreadPoolExecutor(3) as ex:
        segs = list(ex.map(lambda p: render_segment(ctx, *p), enumerate(edl["segments"])))
    print(f"[render] segments ready ({len(segs)})", flush=True)

    lst = ctx.work / "concat.txt"
    lst.write_text("".join(f"file '{p.relative_to(ctx.work).as_posix()}'\n" for p in segs), encoding="utf-8")
    base = ctx.work / "base.mkv"
    run_ff(["-f", "concat", "-safe", "0", "-i", lst, "-c", "copy", base], ctx.work, ctx.log)

    ov_inputs, ov_chains, vout, overlay_audio = build_overlays(ctx, spans)
    mix = render_audio(ctx, base, overlay_audio, spans, total)
    print("[render] audio mixed", flush=True)

    # captions / text pops
    fonts = ctx.work / "fonts"
    if not fonts.exists():
        shutil.copytree(PACK / "Fonts", fonts)
    ass = ctx.work / "captions.ass"
    style_for_ass = deep_merge(ctx.style, {"output": {"width": ctx.cap_w, "height": ctx.cap_h}})
    has_ass = captions.build_ass(edl, spans, style_for_ass, ctx.proj / "work" / "transcript.json", ass, ctx.warnings,
                                 modes=ctx.modes, default_mode=ctx.default_mode, game_area=stack_area(ctx))
    tail = f"{vout}ass=captions.ass:fontsdir=fonts,format=yuv420p[vout]" if has_ass else f"{vout}format=yuv420p[vout]"
    chains = ov_chains + [tail]
    script = ctx.work / "video.fc.txt"
    script.write_text(";\n".join(chains), encoding="utf-8")

    out_dir = ctx.proj / "out"
    out_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    out = out_dir / (f"{slug}_preview.mp4" if preview else f"{slug}.mp4")
    flat = [x for inp in ov_inputs for x in inp]
    enc = venc(ctx.enc_final)
    run_ff(["-i", base, *flat, "-i", mix, "-/filter_complex", script, "-map", "[vout]",
            "-map", f"{len(ov_inputs) + 1}:a", *enc, "-r", ctx.FPS,
            "-c:a", "aac", "-b:a", ctx.enc_final.get("audio_bitrate", "192k"), "-movflags", "+faststart",
            "-t", f"{total:.4f}", out], ctx.work, ctx.log)

    if record and not preview:
        A.record_usage(slug, [(a, t if isinstance(t, (int, float)) else -1) for a, t in collect_asset_ids(edl)])
    report = {"output": str(out), "duration_s": round(total, 2), "voice_ref_dbfs": round(ctx.voice_ref, 1),
              "cut_guard": cut_notes, "warnings": ctx.warnings,
              "settings": ctx.settings_notes}                       # [settings] what the switches removed/changed
    (ctx.work / "render_report.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    for w in ctx.warnings:
        print("  warning:", w, file=sys.stderr)
    for n in ctx.settings_notes:                                    # [settings]
        print("  ", n, file=sys.stderr)
    if cut_notes:
        print(f"[render] cut guard extended {len(cut_notes)} boundaries so no word is clipped", flush=True)
    print(f"[render] done -> {out}", flush=True)
    return out

def make_short(slug: str, n: int, win: dict, edl: dict, pj: dict) -> str:
    main_segs = [s for s in edl["segments"] if not s["id"].startswith("cold")]
    segs = [dict(s) for s in main_segs[win["from"]: win["to"] + 1]]
    ids = {s["id"] for s in segs}
    keep = lambda e: e.get("seg") in ids or ("src_at" in e and "seg" not in e and "at" not in e)  # noqa: E731
    skip_text = {"label"}                                # intro titles / speed labels stay in the long video
    texts = [dict(t) for t in edl.get("text", []) if keep(t)
             and not (t.get("style") in skip_text and "SPEED" not in t["text"])
             and not re.search(r"EARLIER|LATER", t["text"], re.I)]      # cold-open segues mean nothing in a short
    hook = win.get("hook") or hook_text(edl, segs, pj, n)
    hook_overlay = {"type": "motion", "template": "hook_banner", "vars": {"text": hook}, "seg": segs[0]["id"],
                    "rel": 0.0, "dur": 3.2}
    from . import settings as SET                          # [settings] shorts.hook_banner / template switches
    use_hook = SET.template_ok(SET.load(slug), "hook_banner")
    overlays = [dict(o) for o in edl.get("overlays", []) if keep(o) and o.get("type") != "transition"
                and o.get("template") not in ("title_card", "subscribe", "time_card", "end_screen")]
    if use_hook:
        overlays.insert(0, hook_overlay)
    for o in overlays:                                    # corner overlays read better centred on a phone
        if o.get("x") is not None and o.get("placement") != "fullscreen":
            o["x"], o["scale"] = 0.5, min(0.32, o.get("scale", 0.45))
    sfx = [dict(e) for e in edl.get("audio", {}).get("sfx", []) if keep(e)
           and not (e.get("rel") is not None and e.get("rel") <= 0 and "rewind" in e.get("asset", ""))]

    # music: whatever bed was playing where the short starts, re-timed into the short
    spans_main = build_spans(edl, lambda i: A.get(i))
    start_out = next(sp.out_start for sp in spans_main if sp.seg_id == segs[0]["id"])
    total = sum(seg_duration(s, lambda i: A.get(i)) for s in segs)
    music = []
    for m in edl.get("audio", {}).get("music", []):
        at = resolve_time(m, spans_main, [], "music") if ("at" in m or "src_at" in m or "seg" in m) else 0.0
        until = m.get("until", 1e9)
        if at is not None and at <= start_out < until:
            music.append({**{k: v for k, v in m.items() if k not in ("at", "until", "src_at", "seg")},
                          "at": 0.0, "until": round(total, 3), "in": round(m.get("in", 0) + start_out - at, 2),
                          "fade_in": 0.2, "fade_out": 0.8})
            break
    if not music and edl.get("audio", {}).get("music"):
        m = edl["audio"]["music"][0]
        music.append({"asset": m["asset"], "at": 0.0, "until": round(total, 3), "fade_in": 0.2, "fade_out": 0.8})

    short = {"version": 1, "project": f"{slug}--short-{n}", "title": hook, "format": "vertical",
             "mode": edl.get("mode", "funny"), "parent": slug, "segments": segs, "overlays": overlays,

def patch(slug: str, fields: dict) -> dict:
    """Apply a partial update with status rules. Raises ValueError on invalid input."""
    if is_short(slug):
        return patch_short(parent_of(slug), slug, fields)
    cur = load(slug)
    fields = dict(fields)
    if "tags" in fields and isinstance(fields["tags"], str):
        fields["tags"] = split_tags(fields["tags"])
    if "hashtags" in fields and isinstance(fields["hashtags"], str):
        fields["hashtags"] = [h if h.startswith("#") else "#" + h for h in fields["hashtags"].replace(",", " ").split()]
    shorts_patch = fields.pop("shorts", None)
    status = fields.pop("status", None)
    if status is not None and status not in STATUSES:
        raise ValueError(f"status must be one of {STATUSES}")
    allowed = USER_FIELDS | TEXT_FIELDS | {"warnings"}
    bad = set(fields) - allowed
    if bad:
        raise ValueError(f"unknown fields: {sorted(bad)}")
    new = {**cur, **fields}
    old_text, new_text = cur.get("thumbnail_text") or "", fields.get("thumbnail_text")
    if new_text and old_text and new_text != old_text:      # keep the image prompts in sync with the text
        for k in ("thumbnail_prompt", "shorts_cover_prompt"):
            if k not in fields and new.get(k):
                new[k] = new[k].replace(f'"{old_text}"', f'"{new_text}"')
    now = datetime.now()
    sched = _parse_dt(new.get("scheduled_at"))
    if new.get("scheduled_at") and not sched:
        raise ValueError("scheduled_at must be an ISO date/time, e.g. 2026-10-12T17:00")
    if status is None:
        if "scheduled_at" in fields and sched:
            status = "scheduled" if sched > now else ("published" if new.get("youtube_url") else "uploaded")
        elif fields.get("youtube_url") and cur["status"] in ("editing", "rendered"):
            status = "published" if (sched and sched <= now) or not sched else "uploaded"
            if sched and sched > now:
                status = "scheduled"
        elif "scheduled_at" in fields and not fields["scheduled_at"] and cur["status"] == "scheduled":
            status = "uploaded"
    if status == "scheduled":
        if not sched:
            raise ValueError("set a schedule date/time before moving to Scheduled")
    if status:
        new["status"] = status
    elif cur.get("stored_status"):
        new["status"] = cur["stored_status"]
    else:
        new["status"] = cur["status"]
    if new["status"] in ("uploaded", "scheduled", "published") and not new.get("uploaded_at"):
        new["uploaded_at"] = now.isoformat(timespec="minutes")
    if shorts_patch:
        by = {s["slug"]: s for s in new["shorts"]}
        for sp in shorts_patch:
            if sp.get("slug") in by:
                _apply_short(by[sp["slug"]], sp)
    return save(slug, new)


"""Deterministic first pass: transcript + signals -> edit.json with dead air removed.

    mcs scaffold ep01 [--max-gap 0.6] [--pad 0.15] [--keep-action 1.2] [--music <asset-id>]

Keeps every spoken word (padded), keeps game/voice peaks with some context, cuts gaps longer than
--max-gap. The planner then layers zooms, SFX, memes, captions emphasis etc. on top of this.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import json

from . import assets as A
from .paths import project_dir


def keep_ranges(words: list[dict], events: list[dict], dur: float, pad: float, max_gap: float,
                keep_action: float, min_len: float = 0.8) -> list[list[float]]:
    rs = [[max(0, w["start"] - pad), min(dur, w["end"] + pad + 0.2)] for w in words]   # ASR ends early: generous tail
    rs += [[max(0, e["t"] - keep_action), min(dur, e["t"] + keep_action)] for e in events]
    rs.sort()
    merged: list[list[float]] = []
    for a, b in rs:
        if merged and a - merged[-1][1] <= max_gap:
            merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], b)
        else:
            merged.append([a, b])
    return [[round(a, 3), round(b, 3)] for a, b in merged if b - a >= min_len]


def scaffold(slug: str, max_gap: float = 0.6, pad: float = 0.18, keep_action: float = 1.2,
             music: str | None = None, force: bool = False) -> None:
    proj = project_dir(slug)
    dest = proj / "edit.json"
    if dest.exists() and not force:
        raise SystemExit("edit.json exists - pass --force to overwrite (it will be backed up)")
    if dest.exists():
        dest.replace(proj / "edit.backup.json")
    pj = json.loads((proj / "project.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    tr_p, sig_p = proj / "work" / "transcript.json", proj / "work" / "signals.json"
    words = []
    if tr_p.exists():
        tr = json.loads(tr_p.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        words = [w for s in tr["segments"] for w in s["words"]]
    sig = json.loads(sig_p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")) if sig_p.exists() else {}
    events = sig.get("voice_peaks", []) + sig.get("game_peaks", [])
    dur = pj["duration_s"]
    from .settings import load as load_settings            # [settings] editing.dead_air_removal / audio.music
    S = load_settings(slug)
    ranges = keep_ranges(words, events, dur, pad, max_gap, keep_action) \
        if (words or events) and S["editing"]["dead_air_removal"] else [[0, dur]]
    segs = [{"id": f"s{i + 1:03d}", "type": "source", "in": a, "out": b} for i, (a, b) in enumerate(ranges)]
    kept = sum(b - a for a, b in ranges)

    if not music and S["audio"]["music"]:
        pick = A.find(A.Query(categories=["music"], moments=["exploring", "building"], roles=["music_bed"],
                              max_risk="low", max_energy=3, project=slug, limit=1))
        music = pick[0]["id"] if pick else None
    edl = {
        "version": 1,
        "project": slug,
        "title": pj.get("title", slug),
        "segments": segs,
        "overlays": [],
        "text": [],
        "audio": {"sfx": [], "bleeps": [],

        "captions": {"enabled": S["captions"]["enabled"], "emphasis_words": [], "hide": []},
    }
    dest.write_text(json.dumps(edl, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"[scaffold] {len(segs)} segments, kept {kept:.0f}s of {dur:.0f}s ({100 * kept / max(dur, 1):.0f}%), "
          f"music={music} -> edit.json")

def _hits(text: str, theme: str) -> int:
    t = " " + re.sub(r"[^a-z' ]", " ", text.lower()) + " "
    return sum(len(re.findall(r"(?<![a-z])" + re.escape(k) + r"(?![a-z])", t)) for k in THEMES[theme]["kw"])


def _theme_of(text: str, prefer: str | None = None) -> str | None:
    scores = {k: _hits(text, k) for k in THEMES}
    scores = {k: v for k, v in scores.items() if v}
    if not scores:
        return None
    best = max(scores.values())
    if prefer in scores and scores[prefer] >= best:
        return prefer
    return max(scores, key=lambda k: (scores[k], -PEAK_ORDER.index(k) if k in PEAK_ORDER else -99))

# Autopilot

Play, stop OBS, close Minecraft. The finished 1080p60 video, the Shorts and `COPY-PASTE.txt` (title options,
description, tags, hashtags, thumbnail prompts) appear in `Finished\<YYYY-MM-DD HH-MM> <title>\`.

Turn it on: UI > Autopilot > switch (or `uv run mcs autopilot enable`). Off by default.

    uv run mcs autopilot run      # foreground loop (the studio UI runs the same loop in a background thread)
    uv run mcs autopilot once     # process what is pending now, then exit  (--no-wait-game, --watch, --output ...)
    uv run mcs autopilot status

Pipeline per recording (one at a time, BELOW_NORMAL priority): project -> transcribe -> analyze -> scaffold ->
autoplan -> render final -> Shorts -> publish.generate (heuristic, no LLM) -> copy to Finished. The project is marked
"rendered" (Publishing board: Awaiting upload).

Audio tracks: 3+ streams = #2 desktop/game, #3 mic, #1 full mix (ignored); 2 streams = #1 treated as the mix;
1 stream = single mixed track. Mic and game are read from the same file via audio stream indexes.

Rules: originals are never touched; no uploads/network; waits while Minecraft runs or OBS records
(`autopilot.wait_for_game`); a file must be stable 30 s, older than 30 s and readable by ffprobe; recordings shorter
than `min_length_s` and files older than `max_age_h` are ignored; failures are recorded and the loop continues.
State: `studio/autopilot_state.json`; worker logs: `studio/autopilot_logs/`.

## Start at Windows login (optional, not created for you)

Win+R, `shell:startup`, new shortcut with target
`cmd /c "cd /d C:\Users\edmem\OneDrive\Desktop\Minecraft Channel\studio && uv run mcs autopilot run"` (run minimized).
A lock file (PID + heartbeat) keeps only one loop active even if the studio is open too.

## B-roll hook

At plan time, if `mcstudio/cinematic.py` exposes `splice_into_edl(edl, slug)` and `projects/<slug>/broll/shots.json`
exists, that places the shots. Otherwise `autoplan.place_broll` places 2-5 muted 1.5-3 s clips from
`projects/<slug>/broll/*.mp4` (or `Stock Library/Minecraft B-Roll/auto/<session>/`) between segments: an establishing
shot, after loot/death/victory beats, in long calm stretches. No clips = no-op.
EOF

content.text:
Autopilot is built and was run end to end on both of your samples. It is off by default, so the only thing you have to do is tick the ON switch on the Autopilot page.

**Restart needed.** I didn't touch the server on :8765, so restart it for the new Autopilot page and API. The studio server starts the Autopilot loop itself, and the loop stays idle until `autopilot.enabled` is on.

## What I changed
- **New:** `mcstudio/autopilot.py`, `tests/test_autopilot.py` (plain asserts, all pass), `docs/AUTOPILOT.md`.
- **`mcstudio/settings.py`:** new global-only `autopilot` section, plus `text` and `paths` setting types.
- **`mcstudio/ingest.py`:** `new_project(..., no_mic=False)` so 1–2 track recordings stay a single mixed track.
- **`mcstudio/autoplan.py`:** the B-roll hook (`broll_clips`, `place_broll`, `cinematic_splice`).
- **`mcstudio/cli.py`:** `mcs autopilot ...`.
- **`mcstudio/server.py`:** `/api/autopilot/*` endpoints, and the loop starts in `serve()`.
- **`ui/index.html` and `ui/app.js`:** the Autopilot page. `node --check ui/app.js` passes.
- Edits are marked `# [autopilot]`.

## Audio tracks
- **3 or more streams:** #2 is desktop/game, #3 is mic, #1 (full mix) is ignored.
- **Exactly 2:** #1 is treated as the mix, and a note is logged.
- **1 stream:** a single mixed track, as before.
- **Same-file support:** it already existed, so I only added `no_mic`. The mic and game sources point at the same file with different `audio_stream` and `stream` indexes.
- **Check on your 3-track sample:** the mic is track 3 and the desktop track is track 2, and the transcript ("Hello, hello") came from the mic track.
